description: Palm Living go-live configuration (plan §0.5 items 12-13; deploy checklist 6 Oct). Apply with: node dist/ops/ops-cli.js configure --workspace <slug> --as <member> --profile palm-golive-config.json [--apply]. Values marked TBC by Palm are left out or null.
_enquiryTypes: PLM-173 (15 Oct 2026): Renovation is on hold until Palm confirms, so it takes no new enquiries; existing ones are kept.

addChecks._note: PLM-174 (path E): on a bespoke job production waits for the technical handover accepted (PLM-165), every custom line's factory requirements confirmed (PLM-166) and the QS step; on other jobs these checks pass by themselves.

routes._removeChecks: PLM-149: the technical measure comes before the drawings and the lead designer's design check replaces the site check; the client's approval is recorded, not ticked by hand.

_projects: PLM-149: the lead designer sends the drawings to the client and records the approval (switch to the Lead Interior Designer role key once PLM-151 adds it); the technical measure is due 5 working days after its task opens (to confirm with Palm). PLM-161 / PLM-167 / PLM-168 (15 Oct 2026): the project (and its draft BOQ) starts by itself once Proposal 2 is accepted and the upfront payment is verified by Finance; the technical team verifies the BOQ and the QS approves it (BOQ R-n) before ordering; the technical designer role verifies it unless Palm names another.
_projectStart: Palm (15 Oct 2026): a project starts only after the owner approved the deal (Settings › Projects › Starting a project › Deal approved).
_purchasing: PLM-159 / PLM-163 / PLM-169 (15 Oct 2026): nothing is ordered before the technical drawings are verified, the BOQ is QS-approved, the client approved any revised price, the QS signed off the order form and confirmed the material list. Someone who approves orders can mark a check not applicable on one order, with a reason.

inspections._source: PLM-150 (13 Oct 2026): two design inspections per joinery / bespoke furniture item; the Lead Interior Designer inspects, the Creative Director on Designed by the Creative Director projects. Days to inspect are TBC by Palm (the default of 2 working days applies).

release._source: PLM-174 (path E, 15 Oct 2026): before a work order on a bespoke job is released, the technical handover pack is accepted, the line's factory requirements are confirmed (or its recipe verified) and the quotation passed QS.

rolePermissions._note: PLM-137: the WhatsApp inbox is the Sales Admin's intake (the unassigned chats and the Sales team's, crm.inbox.team), and only the Sales Admin sends Closing the chat.

design._steps: PLM-140 to PLM-144 (13 Oct 2026): team allocated the day the fee is paid; first concept 7 days after the kick-off (4-7, set per job by the lead designer); site measure within 3 days of the kick-off; design development 2-8 weeks for the client (7 days per room between them, an assumption until Palm confirms); samples collected within a week and the sample meeting the week after; 1 or 2 concept options. The kick-off within 5 days of inspiration ending is an assumption until Palm confirms.

_clientUpdates: PLM-179: each job's weekly client update is a call with the Account Manager or a written progress update in the client portal, whichever they do; no call is booked by default.

clientPortal._source: PLM-170 (15 Oct 2026): clients of fit-out, ID & furniture, renovation and bespoke joinery jobs see the bill of quantities at selling rates in their portal; never cost or margin.

catalogCategories._note: Core Collection import (5 Oct) made its block titles categories in capitals beside the catalogue's own. Merge runs first, then empty duplicates go, then renames and parents.

_finishes: PLM-146, PLM-148, PLM-156, PLM-157 (13 Oct 2026): the finishes schedule's categories (Palm's batch sheet: hard and soft finishes, whitegoods, sanitary ware, lighting, sockets); the client signs the physical samples and data sheets of sanitary ware and whitegoods before procurement orders; the final quotation (Proposal 2) waits for the final specification (samples approved and the finishes sent to QS); the lead and junior interior designers and the Sales Admin edit the quotation's material column. The 3 days to send the finishes to QS and the sample library's price bands (names only, no amounts yet) are assumptions until Palm confirms.

inbox._note: PLM-137: Palm's three closing messages (English). {{form_link}} is left to the firm's published enquiry form until Palm gives a link.

closingMessages.received: Thank you, {{name}}! Your enquiry is now with our team. An Account Manager will contact you shortly. – Palm Living Interiors
closingMessages.form: Hi {{name}}, to take your enquiry forward, please complete this short form: {{form_link}}. Once we receive it, our team will be in touch.
closingMessages.closing: Hi {{name}}, we haven't heard back from you, so we'll close this chat for now. If you'd like to continue with your project, simply message us here anytime and we'll be happy to help. – Palm Living Interiors

sales._note: PLM-155: timeline questions go to the design team and Production. New enquiries and chats go round-robin, not to the lightest load. PLM-180: hand-offs keep rotating; an enquiry nobody picks up within a working day goes back to Unassigned and the Owners are told.

enquiryRequirements._note: PLM-096 / PLM-155: location and the client's target completion before the Intro (plot size and floor plan are already required to book it).
